keyPoints.en: Skim for gist, scan for details.
keyPoints.bm: Baca luncur untuk gambaran umum, baca imbas untuk butiran.

keyPoints.en: Main idea = what the paragraph is about (often the topic sentence); supporting details explain it.
keyPoints.bm: Idea utama = perkara yang dibincangkan perenggan (sering ayat topik); butiran sokongan menerangkannya.

keyPoints.en: Fact: can be proved (dates, numbers, records). Opinion: personal view (I think, best, delicious).
keyPoints.bm: Fakta: boleh dibuktikan (tarikh, nombor, rekod). Pendapat: pandangan peribadi (I think, best, delicious).

keyPoints.en: Advertisements often present opinions as facts — look for evidence.
keyPoints.bm: Iklan sering menyampaikan pendapat seolah-olah fakta — cari bukti.

keyPoints.en: Inference: use clues (actions, weather, expressions) to find hidden meaning.
keyPoints.bm: Inferens: gunakan petunjuk (tindakan, cuaca, riak wajah) untuk mencari maksud tersirat.

keyPoints.en: Sequencing uses time words; a summary keeps key points in your own words without opinions.
keyPoints.bm: Urutan menggunakan kata masa; ringkasan mengekalkan isi penting dengan perkataan sendiri tanpa pendapat.
